newsitem.title: Lebanon: Israeli helicopters attack southeast Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters attack southeast Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli helicopters rocketed suspected guerrilla targets in southeastern Lebanon before dawn on Wednesday, security sources said.
They said the helicopters fired rockets into an area around the villages of Qilya and Mazra'at ad-Dallafi just outside the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
"They bombarded the area with air-to-surface missiles," one source said. There was no immediate report of casualties.
"There are routes used by the guerrillas there," the source added.
After firing the rockets, the helicopters strafed the area with heavy machineguns for about 30 minutes, the sources added.
They said Israeli helicopters also strafed the surroundings of Qilya, Mazra'at Lucy and the Litani River basin for more than an hour before midnight.
It was not immediately known if there were any guerrilla raids against the Israeli-held zone before the air attacks.

Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas and other fighters are waging war on some 1,000 Israeli troops and an estimated 3,000 allied militiamen of the South Lebanon Army in the zone in a bid to oust them.
